<?php
class Receiver69Catch {
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER|'; }
    public function &stream(&$item) {
        global $weakGiven, $weakOwner;
        try {
            echo 'ENTER|';
            Fiber::suspend('before69');
            echo 'FIRST|';
            yield $item;
            echo 'BAD-TAIL|';
        } catch (Exception $caught) {
            echo 'CAUGHT|', (int) ($caught === $weakGiven->get()), '|';
            echo 'BODY|', (int) ($this === $weakOwner->get()), '|';
            yield $item;
            echo 'AFTER-YIELD|';
        }
        return 69;
    }
}
function Make69Catch() {
    global $weakGiven;
    $value = new Exception('given69');
    $weakGiven = WeakReference::create($value);
    return $value;
}
function Run69Catch() {
    global $g, $old;
    echo 'CALL|';
    $value = $g->throw(Make69Catch());
    echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($value === 7), '|';
    $old = 11;
    echo 'LIVE|', (int) ($g->current() === 11), '|', (int) ($value === 7), '|';
    return 'fiber69';
}
$owner = new Receiver69Catch();
$weakOwner = WeakReference::create($owner);
$slot = 5;
$old =& $slot;
$g = $owner->stream($slot);
unset($owner);
echo 'FRESH|';
$f = new Fiber('Run69Catch');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'before69'), '|';
$replacement = 9;
$slot =& $replacement;
$old = 7;
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|',
     (int) ($slot === 9), '|',
     (int) ($weakOwner->get() !== null), '|',
     (int) ($weakGiven->get() !== null), '|';
try {
    $g->next();
    echo 'BAD-REENTRY|';
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo 'ERROR|', (int) ($error->getMessage() === 'Cannot resume an already running generator'),
         '|', (int) ($error->getPrevious() !== null), '|',
         (int) ($error->getPrevious()->getMessage() === 'Cannot resume an already running generator'), '|',
         (int) ($error->getPrevious()->getPrevious() === null), '|';
}
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume() === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber69'), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 69), '|',
     (int) ($weakOwner->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakGiven->get() === null), '|';
unset($g, $f, $slot, $old, $replacement, $error, $weakOwner, $weakGiven);
echo 'E';
